pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionC: Blue cardboard box with blue marking
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Yellow bags are strictly designated for incinerable organic/pathological wastes: human anatomical tissues, organs, placenta, soiled cotton dressings, and expired cytotoxic drugs.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Red bags are designated for contaminated recyclable plastic medical items: IV sets, catheters, tubing, gloves, and vacutainers subjected to autoclaving and recycling.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionB: Meticulous hand hygiene (5 moments of hand hygiene)
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionD: Wearing double gloves for all procedures
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionA: Auscultating air insufflation over the epigastrium with a stethoscope
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionD: Immersing the tube tip in water to watch for bubbles
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionD: No impact on BP reading accuracy

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionA: Use white correction fluid (whitener) to cover the error completely

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionC: Scribble out the error heavily so it cannot be read
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionD: Tear out the page and rewrite the chart note

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Medico-legal standards dictate drawing a single line through the incorrect entry (so original text remains legible), writing "Error" or "Mistaken Entry", and signing with date/time.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.optionB: 0.05 mL Intradermal in left upper arm
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The universal cold chain temperature standard for health facilities and ILRs in India is maintained strictly between +2°C and +8°C at all times.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: MMR is calculated per 100,000 (1 Lakh) live births, whereas Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and Crude Birth Rate (CBR) are expressed per 1,000 live births.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Horrocks’ apparatus is used to estimate the bleaching powder needed to disinfect 455 liters (100 gallons) of water. The Orthotolidine (OT/OTA) test measures free and combined residual chlorine.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which index is calculated as the ratio of weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters (kg/m²)?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which index is calculated as the ratio of weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters (kg/m²)?

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following epidemiological study designs is considered the gold standard for establishing true causal relationships between interventions and outcomes?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following epidemiological study designs is considered the gold standard for establishing true causal relationships between interventions and outcomes?
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: RSMSSB Rajasthan Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (RSMSSB GNM Direct Recruitment Final Key (Advt 03/2023))
pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Double-blinded Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) minimize confounding and bias through random allocation, representing the gold standard in epidemiological evidence hierarchy.

pyq-raj-rssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?

pyq-ts-mhsrb-nurse-2026.answerSource: TS MHSRB Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (TS MHSRB Notification 02/2023 Final Key)
pyq-ts-mhsrb-nurse-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

pyq-ts-mhsrb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Total 24-hr Parkland fluid = 4 mL × 60 kg × 40% = 9,600 mL Ringer Lactate. Half (50% = 4,800 mL) is given over the first 8 hours from time of injury, and remaining half over next 16 hours.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA), which IV fluid is indicated once the patient’s blood glucose drops below 250 mg/dL during regular insulin infusion?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Adding 5% Dextrose when glucose drops below 250 mg/dL prevents rapid hypoglycemia and cerebral edema while allowing continued insulin infusion to resolve ketoacidosis.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with liver cirrhosis presents with grade III hepatic encephalopathy and elevated blood ammonia. Which medication is the frontline standard to trap and eliminate ammonia via bowel movements?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Acute allograft rejection manifests as oliguria, progressive rise in serum creatinine/BUN, graft site tenderness/swelling, fever, and fluid retention.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Tension pneumothorax is an immediate clinical emergency. Decompression with a 14G/16G needle at 2nd intercostal space midclavicular line (or 4th/5th ICS anterior axillary line) must not await X-ray confirmation.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Within 10 minutes of starting a Packed Red Blood Cell (PRBC) transfusion, the patient develops chills, fever, lower back pain, and dark burgundy urine. What is the nurse’s immediate first action?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with chronic CO2 retention requires supplemental oxygen. Which delivery device and target SpO2 range is most appropriate?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Patients with chronic hypercapnia rely on hypoxic drive. Controlled low-flow oxygen via a Venturi mask targeting SpO2 88–92% prevents worsening hypercapnic respiratory failure and CO2 narcosis.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A young adult with a long bone femur fracture suddenly develops dyspnea, confusion, tachypnea, and petechial rash over the chest and conjunctiva 24 hours post-trauma. What syndrome should the nurse suspect?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In a Mass Casualty Incident (START Triage system), a victim who is non-ambulatory, has respiratory rate of 24/min, radial pulse present, and obeys commands should be assigned which triage tag color?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: In third-degree (complete) AV block, no atrial impulses conduct to the ventricles. Atria and ventricles beat completely independently (AV dissociation) with separate regular P-P and R-R intervals.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: 10% Calcium Gluconate (1 g in 10 mL IV push over 3–5 minutes) acts as a direct physiologic antagonist to magnesium at the neuromuscular junction.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which obstetric sign refers to the bluish or purplish discoloration of the cervix, vagina, and vulva caused by increased venous vascularity during early pregnancy?

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal rectum/colon causing functional intestinal obstruction, failure to pass meconium in first 48 hrs, and abdominal distension.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionA: Bile-stained green vomiting and currant jelly stools
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionB: Non-bilious projectile vomiting immediately after feeds with palpable olive-shaped abdominal mass
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Pyloric stenosis presents at 3–6 weeks with non-bilious projectile vomiting, visible gastric peristaltic waves, hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis, and a palpable epigastric olive mass.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: IMNCI fast breathing thresholds: < 2 months = ≥ 60 breaths/min; 2 to 11 months = ≥ 50 breaths/min; 12 months to 5 years = ≥ 40 breaths/min.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Viral croup (parainfluenza) causes subglottic tracheal narrowing producing the characteristic "Steeple sign" on frontal neck radiograph, barking cough, and nocturnal stridor.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionC: Blue cardboard box with blue marking
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Yellow bags are strictly designated for incinerable organic/pathological wastes: human anatomical tissues, organs, placenta, soiled cotton dressings, and expired cytotoxic drugs.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Red bags are designated for contaminated recyclable plastic medical items: IV sets, catheters, tubing, gloves, and vacutainers subjected to autoclaving and recycling.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionB: Meticulous hand hygiene (5 moments of hand hygiene)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionD: Wearing double gloves for all procedures
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionA: Auscultating air insufflation over the epigastrium with a stethoscope
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionD: Immersing the tube tip in water to watch for bubbles
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionD: No impact on BP reading accuracy
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionA: Use white correction fluid (whitener) to cover the error completely
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionB: Draw a single horizontal line through the error, write "Error", and sign with date/initials
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionC: Scribble out the error heavily so it cannot be read
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionD: Tear out the page and rewrite the chart note
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Medico-legal standards dictate drawing a single line through the incorrect entry (so original text remains legible), writing "Error" or "Mistaken Entry", and signing with date/time.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.optionB: 0.05 mL Intradermal in left upper arm
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: The universal cold chain temperature standard for health facilities and ILRs in India is maintained strictly between +2°C and +8°C at all times.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: MMR is calculated per 100,000 (1 Lakh) live births, whereas Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and Crude Birth Rate (CBR) are expressed per 1,000 live births.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Horrocks’ apparatus is used to estimate the bleaching powder needed to disinfect 455 liters (100 gallons) of water. The Orthotolidine (OT/OTA) test measures free and combined residual chlorine.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPSC ESIC Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPSC Recruitment Test (07.07.2024) Final Master Key)
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.explanation: India launched the National Strategic Plan to eliminate TB by 2025, five years ahead of the global Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) target of 2030.

pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-esic-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Manual upward elevation of the fetal presenting part relieves vascular compression on the prolapsed cord until an emergency cesarean section can be performed.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which gestational age does the uterine fundus normally reach the level of the maternal umbilicus in a singleton pregnancy?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Fundal height landmarks: Symphysis pubis = 12 weeks; Midway between pubis & umbilicus = 16 weeks; Umbilicus = 20–22 weeks; Xiphisternum = 36 weeks.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which obstetric sign refers to the bluish or purplish discoloration of the cervix, vagina, and vulva caused by increased venous vascularity during early pregnancy?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which obstetric sign refers to the bluish or purplish discoloration of the cervix, vagina, and vulva caused by increased venous vascularity during early pregnancy?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Chadwick’s sign is bluish/violet discoloration of vulva/vagina/cervix at ~6–8 weeks. Goodell’s sign is cervical softening; Hegar’s sign is softening of the lower uterine isthmus.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Heart rate > 100 (2) + Slow irregular resp (1) + Active flexed tone (2) + Vigorous cry (2) + Acrocyanosis (1) = Total APGAR = 8.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: By what age does the anterior fontanelle (Bregma) normally close in a healthy developing infant?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: By what age does the anterior fontanelle (Bregma) normally close in a healthy developing infant?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The anterior diamond-shaped fontanelle closes between 12 and 18 months of age. The posterior triangular fontanelle (Lambda) closes much earlier, between 6 and 8 weeks (2 months).

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At what age does a typically developing infant first achieve the gross motor milestone of sitting steadily without any support?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At what age does a typically developing infant first achieve the gross motor milestone of sitting steadily without any support?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Gross motor milestones: Holds neck steady = 3 months; Sits with support = 5–6 months; Sits without support = 8 months; Stands with support = 9 months; Walks independently = 12–15 months.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: During phototherapy for neonatal unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, which two anatomical areas MUST be shielded and protected from light exposure at all times?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal rectum/colon causing functional intestinal obstruction, failure to pass meconium in first 48 hrs, and abdominal distension.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.optionA: Bile-stained green vomiting and currant jelly stools

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: IMNCI fast breathing thresholds: < 2 months = ≥ 60 breaths/min; 2 to 11 months = ≥ 50 breaths/min; 12 months to 5 years = ≥ 40 breaths/min.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Viral croup (parainfluenza) causes subglottic tracheal narrowing producing the characteristic "Steeple sign" on frontal neck radiograph, barking cough, and nocturnal stridor.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.optionD: Wearing double gloves for all procedures

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: DSSSB Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (DSSSB Final Answer Key Notification Post Code 02/24)

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?

pyq-dsssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: According to Naegele’s rule, what is the expected date of delivery (EDD) for a pregnant woman whose Last Menstrual Period (LMP) was 10 October 2025?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.answerSource: JIPMER Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (JIPMER Exam Section Official Question Paper & Key)
pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.explanation: 10% Calcium Gluconate (1 g in 10 mL IV push over 3–5 minutes) acts as a direct physiologic antagonist to magnesium at the neuromuscular junction.

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary frontline drug of choice recommended by WHO guidelines for active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL) to prevent Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.explanation: Oxytocin 10 IU IM (or slow IV) immediately after delivery of the baby is the global gold standard uterotonic for AMTSL due to its rapid onset and absence of hypertensive side effects.

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: During fetal heart rate monitoring, late decelerations are observed following uterine contractions. What is the underlying pathophysiological cause?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which gestational age does the uterine fundus normally reach the level of the maternal umbilicus in a singleton pregnancy?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.explanation: Fundal height landmarks: Symphysis pubis = 12 weeks; Midway between pubis & umbilicus = 16 weeks; Umbilicus = 20–22 weeks; Xiphisternum = 36 weeks.

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which obstetric sign refers to the bluish or purplish discoloration of the cervix, vagina, and vulva caused by increased venous vascularity during early pregnancy?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.explanation: Chadwick’s sign is bluish/violet discoloration of vulva/vagina/cervix at ~6–8 weeks. Goodell’s sign is cervical softening; Hegar’s sign is softening of the lower uterine isthmus.

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At what age does a typically developing infant first achieve the gross motor milestone of sitting steadily without any support?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?

pyq-jipmer-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?

pyq-up-upums-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-up-upums-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?

pyq-up-upums-nurse-2026.answerSource: UPUMS Saifai Nursing Officer Master Answer Key (UPUMS CBT Answer Key & Response Sheet Portal)
pyq-up-upums-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-up-upums-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
