pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionD: No impact on BP reading accuracy
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionA: Use white correction fluid (whitener) to cover the error completely

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionC: Scribble out the error heavily so it cannot be read
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionD: Tear out the page and rewrite the chart note
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Medico-legal standards dictate drawing a single line through the incorrect entry (so original text remains legible), writing "Error" or "Mistaken Entry", and signing with date/time.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: The universal cold chain temperature standard for health facilities and ILRs in India is maintained strictly between +2°C and +8°C at all times.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: MMR is calculated per 100,000 (1 Lakh) live births, whereas Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and Crude Birth Rate (CBR) are expressed per 1,000 live births.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Horrocks’ apparatus is used to estimate the bleaching powder needed to disinfect 455 liters (100 gallons) of water. The Orthotolidine (OT/OTA) test measures free and combined residual chlorine.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: India launched the National Strategic Plan to eliminate TB by 2025, five years ahead of the global Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) target of 2030.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionA: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world’s largest health assurance scheme, providing ₹5 Lakh cover per vulnerable family annually for inpatient care across empaneled hospitals.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which index is calculated as the ratio of weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters (kg/m²)?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which index is calculated as the ratio of weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters (kg/m²)?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Body Mass Index (BMI), also known as Quetelet’s Index, is calculated as Weight (kg) / [Height (m)]². Normal Asian cutoff is 18.5–22.9 kg/m².

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following epidemiological study designs is considered the gold standard for establishing true causal relationships between interventions and outcomes?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following epidemiological study designs is considered the gold standard for establishing true causal relationships between interventions and outcomes?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Double-blinded Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) minimize confounding and bias through random allocation, representing the gold standard in epidemiological evidence hierarchy.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In statistical epidemiology, which measure of central tendency represents the most frequently occurring value in a set of observations?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In statistical epidemiology, which measure of central tendency represents the most frequently occurring value in a set of observations?

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A psychiatric patient believes that the Prime Minister of India is communicating secret messages specifically to him through everyday television news broadcasts. What type of delusion is this?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A psychiatric patient believes that the Prime Minister of India is communicating secret messages specifically to him through everyday television news broadcasts. What type of delusion is this?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Delusion of reference is a false fixed belief that innocuous, neutral events, television broadcasts, or remarks by strangers have direct personal significance and hidden meaning meant for them.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which severe adverse effect characterized by acute muscular rigidity, hyperthermia (temp > 40°C), autonomic instability, and elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) is associated with high-potency typical antipsychotics (e.g. Haloperidol)?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which severe adverse effect characterized by acute muscular rigidity, hyperthermia (temp > 40°C), autonomic instability, and elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) is associated with high-potency typical antipsychotics (e.g. Haloperidol)?

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the absolute, most important nursing priority assessment for a patient admitted with major depressive disorder who suddenly appears cheerful, peaceful, and gives away valued personal possessions?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the absolute, most important nursing priority assessment for a patient admitted with major depressive disorder who suddenly appears cheerful, peaceful, and gives away valued personal possessions?

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.optionB: Immediate assessment for active suicide plan and lethality (Suicide Precautions)

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT), which short-acting muscle relaxant is routinely administered to prevent bone fractures and musculoskeletal injuries during the induced therapeutic seizure?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT), which short-acting muscle relaxant is routinely administered to prevent bone fractures and musculoskeletal injuries during the induced therapeutic seizure?

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Succinylcholine is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker that induces complete, brief muscle flaccidity, protecting against physical trauma during electrical grand mal seizure induction.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Displacement shifts emotional impulses from a threatening source (e.g. boss) to a safer target (e.g. kicking the dog or yelling at family). Sublimation channels impulses into socially constructive activities.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the frontline pharmacological agent prescribed for acute alcohol withdrawal to prevent delirium tremens and withdrawal seizures?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the frontline pharmacological agent prescribed for acute alcohol withdrawal to prevent delirium tremens and withdrawal seizures?
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (KPSC Staff Nurse Final Key Notification)
pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.explanation: Long-acting benzodiazepines provide cross-tolerance to alcohol at GABA-A receptors, stabilizing autonomic hyperactivity and preventing withdrawal seizures and delirium tremens.

pyq-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Wernicke-Korsakoff encephalopathy in chronic alcoholism is caused by a severe dietary deficiency of which essential vitamin?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A young adult with a long bone femur fracture suddenly develops dyspnea, confusion, tachypnea, and petechial rash over the chest and conjunctiva 24 hours post-trauma. What syndrome should the nurse suspect?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: In a Mass Casualty Incident (START Triage system), a victim who is non-ambulatory, has respiratory rate of 24/min, radial pulse present, and obeys commands should be assigned which triage tag color?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: In third-degree (complete) AV block, no atrial impulses conduct to the ventricles. Atria and ventricles beat completely independently (AV dissociation) with separate regular P-P and R-R intervals.

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Loss of deep tendon reflexes (patellar reflex) is the earliest clinical sign of hypermagnesemia (serum Mg 8–10 mEq/L), preceding respiratory depression (<12/min) and cardiac arrest (>15 mEq/L).

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific, life-saving antidote administered for acute Magnesium Sulfate toxicity in an obstetric patient?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: KPSC Karnataka Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (Karnataka Public Service Commission Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: 10% Calcium Gluconate (1 g in 10 mL IV push over 3–5 minutes) acts as a direct physiologic antagonist to magnesium at the neuromuscular junction.

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary frontline drug of choice recommended by WHO guidelines for active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL) to prevent Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Oxytocin 10 IU IM (or slow IV) immediately after delivery of the baby is the global gold standard uterotonic for AMTSL due to its rapid onset and absence of hypertensive side effects.

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Lochia progression: Lochia Rubra (Days 1–3, red blood); Lochia Serosa (Days 4–10, pink/brownish serous); Lochia Alba (Days 10–21, yellowish-white mucus/leukocytes).

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Chadwick’s sign is bluish/violet discoloration of vulva/vagina/cervix at ~6–8 weeks. Goodell’s sign is cervical softening; Hegar’s sign is softening of the lower uterine isthmus.

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: By what age does the anterior fontanelle (Bregma) normally close in a healthy developing infant?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?

mock-kpsc-kar-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Yellow bags are strictly designated for incinerable organic/pathological wastes: human anatomical tissues, organs, placenta, soiled cotton dressings, and expired cytotoxic drugs.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionB: Meticulous hand hygiene (5 moments of hand hygiene)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionD: Wearing double gloves for all procedures
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionA: Auscultating air insufflation over the epigastrium with a stethoscope
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionD: Immersing the tube tip in water to watch for bubbles
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionD: No impact on BP reading accuracy

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: The universal cold chain temperature standard for health facilities and ILRs in India is maintained strictly between +2°C and +8°C at all times.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: MMR is calculated per 100,000 (1 Lakh) live births, whereas Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and Crude Birth Rate (CBR) are expressed per 1,000 live births.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Horrocks’ apparatus is used to estimate the bleaching powder needed to disinfect 455 liters (100 gallons) of water. The Orthotolidine (OT/OTA) test measures free and combined residual chlorine.

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Model Key)
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which index is calculated as the ratio of weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in meters (kg/m²)?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following epidemiological study designs is considered the gold standard for establishing true causal relationships between interventions and outcomes?

pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A psychiatric patient believes that the Prime Minister of India is communicating secret messages specifically to him through everyday television news broadcasts. What type of delusion is this?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A psychiatric patient believes that the Prime Minister of India is communicating secret messages specifically to him through everyday television news broadcasts. What type of delusion is this?
pyq-mp-esb-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Within 10 minutes of starting a Packed Red Blood Cell (PRBC) transfusion, the patient develops chills, fever, lower back pain, and dark burgundy urine. What is the nurse’s immediate first action?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Standard clinical guidelines (AHA/ASA) approve IV thrombolysis with rt-PA within 3 to 4.5 hours of documented ischemic stroke symptom onset in eligible patients without contraindications.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: AHA/ERC guidelines mandate a compression-to-ventilation ratio of 30:2 at a depth of 5–6 cm and rate of 100–120 compressions/min for all single-rescuer adult CPR.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with chronic CO2 retention requires supplemental oxygen. Which delivery device and target SpO2 range is most appropriate?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Patients with chronic hypercapnia rely on hypoxic drive. Controlled low-flow oxygen via a Venturi mask targeting SpO2 88–92% prevents worsening hypercapnic respiratory failure and CO2 narcosis.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A young adult with a long bone femur fracture suddenly develops dyspnea, confusion, tachypnea, and petechial rash over the chest and conjunctiva 24 hours post-trauma. What syndrome should the nurse suspect?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: In a Mass Casualty Incident (START Triage system), a victim who is non-ambulatory, has respiratory rate of 24/min, radial pulse present, and obeys commands should be assigned which triage tag color?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.optionC: Fixed prolonged PR interval > 0.20 seconds with 1:1 conduction
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.optionD: Sawtooth baseline flutter waves at 300 bpm
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: In third-degree (complete) AV block, no atrial impulses conduct to the ventricles. Atria and ventricles beat completely independently (AV dissociation) with separate regular P-P and R-R intervals.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: In suspected placenta previa (painless bright red bleeding in third trimester), digital vaginal examination is strictly contraindicated as finger insertion can disrupt placental attachments and trigger catastrophic hemorrhage.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with severe preeclampsia is receiving an intravenous infusion of Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4). Which finding represents early signs of Magnesium toxicity requiring immediate withholding of the infusion?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Loss of deep tendon reflexes (patellar reflex) is the earliest clinical sign of hypermagnesemia (serum Mg 8–10 mEq/L), preceding respiratory depression (<12/min) and cardiac arrest (>15 mEq/L).

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: 10% Calcium Gluconate (1 g in 10 mL IV push over 3–5 minutes) acts as a direct physiologic antagonist to magnesium at the neuromuscular junction.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary frontline drug of choice recommended by WHO guidelines for active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL) to prevent Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary frontline drug of choice recommended by WHO guidelines for active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL) to prevent Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Oxytocin 10 IU IM (or slow IV) immediately after delivery of the baby is the global gold standard uterotonic for AMTSL due to its rapid onset and absence of hypertensive side effects.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal rectum/colon causing functional intestinal obstruction, failure to pass meconium in first 48 hrs, and abdominal distension.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.optionA: Bile-stained green vomiting and currant jelly stools

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: IMNCI fast breathing thresholds: < 2 months = ≥ 60 breaths/min; 2 to 11 months = ≥ 50 breaths/min; 12 months to 5 years = ≥ 40 breaths/min.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Viral croup (parainfluenza) causes subglottic tracheal narrowing producing the characteristic "Steeple sign" on frontal neck radiograph, barking cough, and nocturnal stridor.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.optionB: 0.05 mL Intradermal in left upper arm
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.answerSource: MP ESB Group 5 Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (MP Employees Selection Board Official Syllabus Model Paper)
mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

mock-mp-esb-nurse-2026-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: By what age does the anterior fontanelle (Bregma) normally close in a healthy developing infant?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.answerSource: Haryana HSSC Staff Nurse CET Master Answer Key (HSSC Group C CET Mains Final Key)

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.answerSource: Haryana HSSC Staff Nurse CET Master Answer Key (HSSC Group C CET Mains Final Key)
pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?
pyq-hssc-har-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?

pyq-punjab-bfuhs-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?

pyq-punjab-bfuhs-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?

pyq-jkssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?

pyq-jkssb-nurse-2026.answerSource: JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (JKSSB Health & Medical Education Dept Final Key)

pyq-jkssb-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?

pyq-jkssb-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

mock-jkssb-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.answerSource: Assam DME Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (Assam DME Staff Nurse Merit & Key Notice)
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.explanation: The anterior diamond-shaped fontanelle closes between 12 and 18 months of age. The posterior triangular fontanelle (Lambda) closes much earlier, between 6 and 8 weeks (2 months).

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At what age does a typically developing infant first achieve the gross motor milestone of sitting steadily without any support?
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At what age does a typically developing infant first achieve the gross motor milestone of sitting steadily without any support?

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.answerSource: Assam DME Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (Assam DME Staff Nurse Merit & Key Notice)
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.explanation: Gross motor milestones: Holds neck steady = 3 months; Sits with support = 5–6 months; Sits without support = 8 months; Stands with support = 9 months; Walks independently = 12–15 months.

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.optionB: Eyes (with opaque eye patches) and Genitalia (gonads)
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.answerSource: Assam DME Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (Assam DME Staff Nurse Merit & Key Notice)
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.explanation: Phototherapy lights can cause retinal photochemical injury and testicular/gonadal hyperthermic damage, requiring continuous eye shields and diaper coverage.

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.answerSource: Assam DME Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (Assam DME Staff Nurse Merit & Key Notice)
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.explanation: Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal rectum/colon causing functional intestinal obstruction, failure to pass meconium in first 48 hrs, and abdominal distension.

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.optionA: Bile-stained green vomiting and currant jelly stools
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.optionB: Non-bilious projectile vomiting immediately after feeds with palpable olive-shaped abdominal mass
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.answerSource: Assam DME Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (Assam DME Staff Nurse Merit & Key Notice)
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.explanation: Pyloric stenosis presents at 3–6 weeks with non-bilious projectile vomiting, visible gastric peristaltic waves, hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis, and a palpable epigastric olive mass.

pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
pyq-assam-dme-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
