pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Red bags are designated for contaminated recyclable plastic medical items: IV sets, catheters, tubing, gloves, and vacutainers subjected to autoclaving and recycling.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionB: Meticulous hand hygiene (5 moments of hand hygiene)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionD: Wearing double gloves for all procedures
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionA: Auscultating air insufflation over the epigastrium with a stethoscope
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionD: Immersing the tube tip in water to watch for bubbles
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionD: No impact on BP reading accuracy
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: If a nurse makes an erroneous entry in a manual hospital medical chart, what is the legally correct documentation procedure to rectify the mistake?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionA: Use white correction fluid (whitener) to cover the error completely
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionB: Draw a single horizontal line through the error, write "Error", and sign with date/initials
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionC: Scribble out the error heavily so it cannot be read
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionD: Tear out the page and rewrite the chart note
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Medico-legal standards dictate drawing a single line through the incorrect entry (so original text remains legible), writing "Error" or "Mistaken Entry", and signing with date/time.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionB: 0.05 mL Intradermal in left upper arm
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: The universal cold chain temperature standard for health facilities and ILRs in India is maintained strictly between +2°C and +8°C at all times.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: MMR is calculated per 100,000 (1 Lakh) live births, whereas Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and Crude Birth Rate (CBR) are expressed per 1,000 live births.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Horrocks’ apparatus is used to estimate the bleaching powder needed to disinfect 455 liters (100 gallons) of water. The Orthotolidine (OT/OTA) test measures free and combined residual chlorine.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP), what is the overarching target year set by the Government of India to achieve TB elimination in India?

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.answerSource: CNCI Kolkata Staff Nurse (Oncology) Master Answer Key (CNCI Kolkata Official CBT Key)
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.explanation: India launched the National Strategic Plan to eliminate TB by 2025, five years ahead of the global Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) target of 2030.

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?
pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which flagship government health scheme provides cashless annual health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in India?

pyq-cnci-kolkata-nurse-2026.optionA: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.answerSource: SSB Sub-Inspector Staff Nurse Master Answer Key (SSB Recruitment Directorate Official Key)
pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?

pyq-ssb-mha-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionA: Absence of deep tendon reflexes (Patellar reflex)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Loss of deep tendon reflexes (patellar reflex) is the earliest clinical sign of hypermagnesemia (serum Mg 8–10 mEq/L), preceding respiratory depression (<12/min) and cardiac arrest (>15 mEq/L).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific, life-saving antidote administered for acute Magnesium Sulfate toxicity in an obstetric patient?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific, life-saving antidote administered for acute Magnesium Sulfate toxicity in an obstetric patient?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionA: Calcium Gluconate 10% IV (10 mL slowly over 5–10 minutes)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: 10% Calcium Gluconate (1 g in 10 mL IV push over 3–5 minutes) acts as a direct physiologic antagonist to magnesium at the neuromuscular junction.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary frontline drug of choice recommended by WHO guidelines for active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL) to prevent Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary frontline drug of choice recommended by WHO guidelines for active management of the third stage of labor (AMTSL) to prevent Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Oxytocin 10 IU IM (or slow IV) immediately after delivery of the baby is the global gold standard uterotonic for AMTSL due to its rapid onset and absence of hypertensive side effects.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Lochia progression: Lochia Rubra (Days 1–3, red blood); Lochia Serosa (Days 4–10, pink/brownish serous); Lochia Alba (Days 10–21, yellowish-white mucus/leukocytes).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: During fetal heart rate monitoring, late decelerations are observed following uterine contractions. What is the underlying pathophysiological cause?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: During fetal heart rate monitoring, late decelerations are observed following uterine contractions. What is the underlying pathophysiological cause?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: VEAL CHOP mnemonic: Variable = Cord compression; Early = Head compression; Accelerations = Ok; Late decelerations = Placental insufficiency requiring left lateral positioning, O2, and stopping oxytocin.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionD: Encourage the mother to bear down and push vigorously
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Manual upward elevation of the fetal presenting part relieves vascular compression on the prolapsed cord until an emergency cesarean section can be performed.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which gestational age does the uterine fundus normally reach the level of the maternal umbilicus in a singleton pregnancy?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which gestational age does the uterine fundus normally reach the level of the maternal umbilicus in a singleton pregnancy?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Fundal height landmarks: Symphysis pubis = 12 weeks; Midway between pubis & umbilicus = 16 weeks; Umbilicus = 20–22 weeks; Xiphisternum = 36 weeks.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which obstetric sign refers to the bluish or purplish discoloration of the cervix, vagina, and vulva caused by increased venous vascularity during early pregnancy?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which obstetric sign refers to the bluish or purplish discoloration of the cervix, vagina, and vulva caused by increased venous vascularity during early pregnancy?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Chadwick’s sign is bluish/violet discoloration of vulva/vagina/cervix at ~6–8 weeks. Goodell’s sign is cervical softening; Hegar’s sign is softening of the lower uterine isthmus.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A newborn baby evaluated at 1 minute after birth: Heart rate 110 bpm, slow irregular respirations, active flexed motion, vigorous cry on suctioning, pink body with blue extremities (acrocyanosis). What is the APGAR score?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Heart rate > 100 (2) + Slow irregular resp (1) + Active flexed tone (2) + Vigorous cry (2) + Acrocyanosis (1) = Total APGAR = 8.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: By what age does the anterior fontanelle (Bregma) normally close in a healthy developing infant?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: By what age does the anterior fontanelle (Bregma) normally close in a healthy developing infant?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: The anterior diamond-shaped fontanelle closes between 12 and 18 months of age. The posterior triangular fontanelle (Lambda) closes much earlier, between 6 and 8 weeks (2 months).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At what age does a typically developing infant first achieve the gross motor milestone of sitting steadily without any support?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Gross motor milestones: Holds neck steady = 3 months; Sits with support = 5–6 months; Sits without support = 8 months; Stands with support = 9 months; Walks independently = 12–15 months.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Phototherapy lights can cause retinal photochemical injury and testicular/gonadal hyperthermic damage, requiring continuous eye shields and diaper coverage.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal rectum/colon causing functional intestinal obstruction, failure to pass meconium in first 48 hrs, and abdominal distension.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionA: Bile-stained green vomiting and currant jelly stools

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Pyloric stenosis presents at 3–6 weeks with non-bilious projectile vomiting, visible gastric peristaltic waves, hypochloremic metabolic alkalosis, and a palpable epigastric olive mass.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: IMNCI fast breathing thresholds: < 2 months = ≥ 60 breaths/min; 2 to 11 months = ≥ 50 breaths/min; 12 months to 5 years = ≥ 40 breaths/min.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Viral croup (parainfluenza) causes subglottic tracheal narrowing producing the characteristic "Steeple sign" on frontal neck radiograph, barking cough, and nocturnal stridor.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under BMW rules, contaminated recyclable plastic waste such as used IV tubing, Foley catheters, urine bags, and disposable syringes (without needles) must be disposed of in which color bin?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionB: Meticulous hand hygiene (5 moments of hand hygiene)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionD: Wearing double gloves for all procedures
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionD: Immersing the tube tip in water to watch for bubbles
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: N-Acetylcysteine replenishes hepatic glutathione stores, neutralizing the toxic paracetamol metabolite NAPQI (N-acetyl-p-benzoquinone imine).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Organophosphate / Insecticide poisoning characterized by SLUDGE syndrome (salivation, lacrimation, urination, diarrhea, emesis), which drug is the physiological antidote?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Atropine competitively blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors to reverse bronchial secretions and bradycardia, while Pralidoxime reactivates inhibited acetylcholinesterase enzyme.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A patient with Bipolar Disorder is prescribed Lithium Carbonate. What is the narrow therapeutic serum range for maintenance lithium therapy?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Therapeutic lithium range is 0.6–1.2 mEq/L. Levels > 1.5 mEq/L produce early toxicity (vomiting, coarse tremors, ataxia), and > 2.0 mEq/L can cause seizures, coma, and death.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following anti-tubercular drugs is most notorious for causing peripheral neuropathy, which can be prevented by co-prescribing Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Isoniazid (INH) interferes with vitamin B6 metabolism, leading to dose-dependent peripheral neuropathy. Co-administration of 10–25 mg/day Pyridoxine prevents this adverse effect.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which anti-tubercular medication causes retrobulbar optic neuritis leading to decreased visual acuity and loss of green-red color discrimination?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Ethambutol (mnemonic: "E" for Eye) is known for ocular toxicity (optic neuritis). Monthly visual acuity and Ishihara color discrimination testing is mandatory.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the primary mechanism of action of Heparin in preventing thrombus formation?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionA: Accelerating the inhibitory action of Antithrombin III against Thrombin and Factor Xa
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionB: Direct inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Heparin binds to antithrombin III, inducing a conformational change that accelerates its inhibition of activated thrombin (Factor IIa) and Factor Xa by over 1000-fold.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the National Immunization Schedule (NIS) of India, what is the exact dose and route for administering BCG vaccine to a neonate at birth?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.optionB: 0.05 mL Intradermal in left upper arm

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL after 1 month).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: At which temperature range must the vaccine cold chain be strictly maintained inside Ice-Lined Refrigerators (ILR) for sensitive vaccines like OPV, Measles, and Pentavalent?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: The universal cold chain temperature standard for health facilities and ILRs in India is maintained strictly between +2°C and +8°C at all times.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) is epidemiologically expressed as the number of maternal deaths per how many live births in a given year?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: MMR is calculated per 100,000 (1 Lakh) live births, whereas Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and Crude Birth Rate (CBR) are expressed per 1,000 live births.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which test is utilized in water purification field practice to determine the exact bleaching powder requirement (chlorine demand) to disinfect a water source?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Horrocks’ apparatus is used to estimate the bleaching powder needed to disinfect 455 liters (100 gallons) of water. The Orthotolidine (OT/OTA) test measures free and combined residual chlorine.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the population norm for establishing a Primary Health Centre (PHC) in plain areas and hilly/tribal/difficult areas respectively in India?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Indian public health norms: Sub-centre = 5,000 (Plain) / 3,000 (Hilly); PHC = 30,000 (Plain) / 20,000 (Hilly); CHC = 120,000 (Plain) / 80,000 (Hilly).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A psychiatric patient believes that the Prime Minister of India is communicating secret messages specifically to him through everyday television news broadcasts. What type of delusion is this?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A psychiatric patient believes that the Prime Minister of India is communicating secret messages specifically to him through everyday television news broadcasts. What type of delusion is this?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which severe adverse effect characterized by acute muscular rigidity, hyperthermia (temp > 40°C), autonomic instability, and elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) is associated with high-potency typical antipsychotics (e.g. Haloperidol)?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which severe adverse effect characterized by acute muscular rigidity, hyperthermia (temp > 40°C), autonomic instability, and elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) is associated with high-potency typical antipsychotics (e.g. Haloperidol)?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT), which short-acting muscle relaxant is routinely administered to prevent bone fractures and musculoskeletal injuries during the induced therapeutic seizure?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT), which short-acting muscle relaxant is routinely administered to prevent bone fractures and musculoskeletal injuries during the induced therapeutic seizure?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Succinylcholine is a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker that induces complete, brief muscle flaccidity, protecting against physical trauma during electrical grand mal seizure induction.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following defense mechanisms involves redirecting unacceptable impulses, anger, or aggressive feelings toward a less threatening, safer substitute target?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Displacement shifts emotional impulses from a threatening source (e.g. boss) to a safer target (e.g. kicking the dog or yelling at family). Sublimation channels impulses into socially constructive activities.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the frontline pharmacological agent prescribed for acute alcohol withdrawal to prevent delirium tremens and withdrawal seizures?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the frontline pharmacological agent prescribed for acute alcohol withdrawal to prevent delirium tremens and withdrawal seizures?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Long-acting benzodiazepines provide cross-tolerance to alcohol at GABA-A receptors, stabilizing autonomic hyperactivity and preventing withdrawal seizures and delirium tremens.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Wernicke-Korsakoff encephalopathy in chronic alcoholism is caused by a severe dietary deficiency of which essential vitamin?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Wernicke-Korsakoff encephalopathy in chronic alcoholism is caused by a severe dietary deficiency of which essential vitamin?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.answerSource: NPCIL Nurse A (DAE) Master Answer Key (NPCIL DAE Nurse A Written Exam Key)
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Thiamine (B1) deficiency leads to Wernicke encephalopathy (triad: ophthalmoplegia, ataxia, confusion) and irreversible Korsakoff psychosis (confabulation and amnesia).

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which eating disorder is characterized by recurrent binge eating episodes followed by compensatory purging behaviors (self-induced vomiting, laxative abuse) with normal or near-normal body weight?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which eating disorder is characterized by recurrent binge eating episodes followed by compensatory purging behaviors (self-induced vomiting, laxative abuse) with normal or near-normal body weight?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Bulimia nervosa features recurrent binging and inappropriate compensatory purging while maintaining normal weight. Anorexia nervosa is characterized by severe underweight (BMI < 17.5) and body distortion.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which atypical second-generation antipsychotic carries a mandatory requirement for weekly Complete Blood Count (CBC) monitoring due to the risk of life-threatening Agranulocytosis?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Clozapine carries a black-box warning for agranulocytosis (severe drop in Absolute Neutrophil Count < 500/mm³), necessitating strict baseline and routine ANC blood monitoring.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The therapeutic nurse-patient relationship progresses through which chronological phases as outlined by Hildegard Peplau?
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The therapeutic nurse-patient relationship progresses through which chronological phases as outlined by Hildegard Peplau?

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.explanation: Peplau’s interpersonal nursing model outlines four phases: Orientation (problem recognition), Identification, Exploitation/Working (therapeutic interventions), and Resolution/Termination.

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: In a clinical research study, the probability of rejecting a true null hypothesis when it is actually true (false positive) is known as:
pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: In a clinical research study, the probability of rejecting a true null hypothesis when it is actually true (false positive) is known as:

pyq-npcil-dae-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: According to NABH / JCI patient safety standards, what is the mandatory protocol executed immediately before surgical incision to confirm correct patient identity, correct procedure, and correct surgical site?

mock-npcil-dae-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Naegele’s Rule = LMP + 7 days - 3 months + 1 year. 10 October + 7 days = 17 October; minus 3 months = 17 July 2026.

mock-npcil-dae-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: Loss of deep tendon reflexes (patellar reflex) is the earliest clinical sign of hypermagnesemia (serum Mg 8–10 mEq/L), preceding respiratory depression (<12/min) and cardiac arrest (>15 mEq/L).

mock-npcil-dae-nurse-2026-2026.explanation: 10% Calcium Gluconate (1 g in 10 mL IV push over 3–5 minutes) acts as a direct physiologic antagonist to magnesium at the neuromuscular junction.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which congenital anomaly is characterized by failure of ganglion cells to migrate to the myenteric plexus of the distal colon, presenting as ribbon-like stools and failure to pass meconium within 48 hours?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal rectum/colon causing functional intestinal obstruction, failure to pass meconium in first 48 hrs, and abdominal distension.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the hallmark clinical presentation of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis in a 4-week-old male infant?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.optionA: Bile-stained green vomiting and currant jelly stools

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Under the Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) guidelines, what is the fast breathing cut-off defining Pneumonia in an infant aged 2 months to 11 months?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: IMNCI fast breathing thresholds: < 2 months = ≥ 60 breaths/min; 2 to 11 months = ≥ 50 breaths/min; 12 months to 5 years = ≥ 40 breaths/min.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A 2-year-old child presents with barking seal-like cough, inspiratory stridor, hoarseness, and low-grade fever worse at night. The neck X-ray reveals the "Steeple sign". What is the diagnosis?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Viral croup (parainfluenza) causes subglottic tracheal narrowing producing the characteristic "Steeple sign" on frontal neck radiograph, barking cough, and nocturnal stridor.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the classic diagnostic triad observed in Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF) with Esophageal Atresia in a newborn at first feed?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: The classic "3 Cs" of TEF are Coughing, Choking, and Cyanosis during feedings, accompanied by excessive frothy salivation and drooling from the mouth.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which primitive neonatal reflex is elicited by suddenly lowering the baby’s head or producing a sudden loud sound, resulting in symmetric abduction and extension of arms followed by flexion and cry?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: The Moro reflex (startle response) consists of arm abduction/extension followed by adduction/flexion. Asymmetric Moro suggests clavicular fracture or brachial plexus injury (Erb’s palsy).

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: According to the revised Bio-Medical Waste (Management & Handling) Rules, in which colored container/bag should human anatomical tissue, placenta, and blood-soaked cotton gauze dressings be segregated?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Yellow bags are strictly designated for incinerable organic/pathological wastes: human anatomical tissues, organs, placenta, soiled cotton dressings, and expired cytotoxic drugs.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which of the following is the single most effective intervention to prevent healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) including CLABSI and CAUTI?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.optionB: Meticulous hand hygiene (5 moments of hand hygiene)

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: WHO and CDC establish that proper hand hygiene (alcohol rub for 20–30s or soap & water for 40–60s) is the primary, most cost-effective measure to eliminate pathogen cross-transmission.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the gold standard method to definitively confirm correct placement of a newly inserted nasogastric (NG) tube before initiating enteral feeds or medications?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: An abdominal/chest X-ray visualizing the tube tip in the stomach below the diaphragm is the absolute gold standard before any feed. Auscultation is unreliable and unsafe.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering a cleansing enema to an adult patient, which position is recommended to facilitate the gravitational flow of the enema solution into the sigmoid colon?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Left lateral Sims’ position (lying on left side with right knee flexed) aligns with anatomical curvature of sigmoid colon and descending colon, facilitating fluid entry.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A blood pressure cuff with a bladder that is too narrow or applied too loosely on a patient’s arm will result in which measurement error?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: A cuff bladder that is too narrow or wrapped too loosely requires excessive cuff inflation pressure to compress the brachial artery, yielding falsely elevated BP readings.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: When administering an Intramuscular (IM) injection of irritating medications (such as iron dextran) to prevent tracking into subcutaneous tissue, which technique must be employed?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: The Z-track technique displaces skin and subcutaneous tissue laterally before injection, sealing the medication track in the muscle layer upon needle withdrawal and preventing leakage/skin staining.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: The ethical principle that mandates healthcare professionals to act in ways that benefit the patient and promote their physical and emotional well-being is known as:

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Beneficence is the ethical duty to do good and promote patient well-being. Non-maleficence is the duty to do no harm; Autonomy is respecting patient decision-making rights.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which intravenous fluid is isotonic and considered the fluid of resuscitation of choice in acute trauma, hypovolemic shock, and severe dehydration?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Ringer Lactate has an electrolyte composition closest to human plasma (Na 130, K 4, Ca 2.7, Cl 109, Lactate 28 mEq/L) and is the frontline crystalloid for shock resuscitation.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The IV bag contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL D5W. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Dose = 5 × 70 = 350 mcg/min = 21,000 mcg/hr = 21 mg/hr. Concentration = 400 mg / 250 mL = 1.6 mg/mL. Rate = 21 / 1.6 = 13.125 ≈ 13.1 mL/hr.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: An IV infusion of 1000 mL Normal Saline is ordered to run over 8 hours using a standard macrodrip administration set with a drop factor of 15 drops/mL. What is the correct drip rate in drops/minute?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Drip rate = (Total Volume in mL × Drop Factor) / Time in Minutes = (1000 × 15) / (8 × 60) = 15,000 / 480 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Protamine sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to acidic Heparin to form an inactive stable salt complex.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific competitive receptor antagonist antidote for acute Opioid (Morphine / Fentanyl) overdose presenting with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression?

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.answerSource: ISRO Nurse B (Dept of Space) Master Answer Key (ISRO URSC Nurse B Official Key Series A)
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.explanation: Naloxone is a pure mu-opioid receptor antagonist that rapidly reverses opioid-induced respiratory depression, sedation, and coma.

pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextOriginal: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
pyq-isro-dos-nurse-2026.questionTextDisplay: Which antidote is administered to prevent acute hepatic necrosis in severe Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) poisoning?
